body: Russian fairytale got iceskating action and women's empowerment drama. Winter cinematography and gorgeous production design created unique cinematic experience for audience to sit through its predictability. Fedotov & Priss made a sweet inter-caste romance here.

Now this movie is a hidden gem, never knew it existed, came across it in Netflix.

If you were a kid who grew up reading lots and lots of fairy tales (and now you do the same for your kids) - this movie will definitely bring back some fond memories and make tou feel good after watching it.

The scenes and the atmosphere were simply mesmerising and magical.

It was an enjoyable experience!

I hereby include this movie in my Christmas movie list!

Wait no longer, make yourselves a cup of cocoa n sink in to a wonderful experience of Russia in the 1900s.

Surprisingly I really enjoyed this movie. Yes the plot was predictable and the performance of the main actors a little bit underwhelming, but overall it was beautifully made.

The cinematography were amazing and the action scenes made it fun to watch. Despite the length of the film I didn't feel bored, and it kept my interest until the end.

I really appreciate that we saw a strong and clever female character and not the typical beautiful princess.

All in all, a nice movie that raises awareness about women's rights and equality.
It is a good option to entertain you for 2 hours; the actors are charismatic, the plot is decent and the cinematography is beautiful; it is a nice love story full of drama and action.

This movie is just fantastic !

Starting with the most beautiful location, St Petersburg !

Casting is great Costumes are so impressive !

Recommend viewing.
